reason_for_selection: Candidate 2A delivers the highest development cross-validation balanced accuracy (49.16%) and highest minority-class recall (25% moderate, 40% severe) while avoiding majority-class collapse on autonomous AI interviews ([18, 1, 5] predicted distribution). It provides the optimal clinical balance between nominal accuracy (78.38%) and life-critical depression detection without test-label overfitting.
known_limitations: The canonical test set (N=37) and unseen cohort (N=33) were observed during earlier capstone milestones; while model selection in this cycle was strictly development-driven, these cohorts must be understood as reserved historical cohorts rather than completely untouched benchmarks.
Acoustic domain shift remains detectable between human WoZ interviews and autonomous avatar interviews; native avatar training data collection is recommended for future work.
Predictions are clinical decision-support screening scores and must not be used as standalone automated medical diagnoses.
